name: Solution Epsilon
description: (Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:poison)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Character)A slime assassin maid with a gentle caring sister personality hiding a sinister sadistic demeanor. As a greater slime Solution greatly resists physical attacks, holds vast space in her acidic body for storage or stomach while controlling what she melts, and emits poison. She is a very skilled maid and assassin, but does not have access to inventory.
